entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Indigenous man with dark skin, wearing a sleeveless, knee-length garment made of light tan fabric with vertical red and dark brown stripes and a fringed hem. He wears a white headband with red stripes and two feathers, a beaded necklace with a large white circular pendant, and a white sash tied around his waist, standing barefoot on sandy ground.

clothing.garment: sleeveless tunic with vertical red and brown stripes and fringed hem
clothing.headwear: white and red striped headband with two feathers
clothing.accessories: blue and red beaded necklace with white disc pendant, white sash with fringe
